fields.summary_ko.0: Sandisk (SNDK) rose +5.9% on competitor SK Hynix (SKHY) guidance that AI memory chip demand will exceed supply through 2030, providing positive catalysts for the memory chip industry.
fields.summary_ko.1: Despite Sandisk rising +650% over the past year, it trades at a 19x P/E, indicating undervaluation, and as one of the big three in memory chips, it should benefit from supply-demand imbalances.
